# hi-repo-recon: hướng dẫn

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-wiki-pages.mjs from SKILL.md; edit the skill, then re-run -->

> Lập bản đồ repository lạ: inventory module, entry-point map và catalog hàm chính; chỉ tạo bằng chứng cấu trúc.

**Mô tả gốc (EN):** Map an unfamiliar repository into an evidence-backed module inventory, entry-point map, and optional key-function catalog. Use for repository onboarding, architecture reconnaissance, handover preparation, or refactor scoping.

## Cách gọi

```text
/hi-repo-recon <repo path> [backend|frontend|infra|data|all] [quick|standard|deep]  — default: standard
```

## Ranh giới

- Do not own build auditing, risk synthesis, or full discovery orchestration.
- Report discrepancies; never invent unindexed modules.
